basis: bHLH for GMC fate that moves into lateral cells to specify subsidiary mother cells; sid/bdmute lacks SCs and YFP-BdMUTE reporters mark GMCs (Raissig et al. 2017 Science; Spiegelhalder et al. 2024 Development). MUTE+FAMA RNA-FISH and top gene of the Dividing GMC clusters (Table S4 lfc 5.0, pct 0.74) (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell). Cross-study raise from medium (stage-restricted: GMC/SMC stages of young leaf zones only).
bHLH initiating stomatal files/asymmetric entry divisions, with BdSPCH2 (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS). Not enriched at Table S4 thresholds in Berg et al. 2026 (low detection); expect few cells.
bHLH for stomatal file establishment; bdspch2 has few stomata (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS). Not enriched at Table S4 thresholds in Berg et al. 2026 (low detection).

ICE/SCRM-class bHLH partner of SPCH/MUTE/FAMA required for stomatal identity (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS; reporter details not checked, full text not accessible). Enriched in Early GC (lfc 3.7, pct 0.66) and GMC clusters in Berg et al. 2026; spans the whole GC lineage.
TOO MANY MOUTHS LRR receptor-like protein; RNA-FISH in stage 0-2 stomatal files and GMCs (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 4e-f). Low detection in scRNA (Early GMC pct 0.16).
Subtilisin-like protease (AtSDD1 homolog); RNA-FISH in GMCs before the symmetric division (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 4h-i); Dividing GMC clusters lfc 5.4, pct 0.60. GMC stage marker.
Uncharacterized LRR receptor kinase; RNA-FISH in GMCs of stages 2-5 (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 4k-l); Dividing GMC clusters lfc 6.0, pct 0.56. GMC stage marker.

Pectin methylesterase; RNA-FISH from stage 2 GMCs to stage 5 GCs and in recruited SCs, CRISPR bdpme53-like forms fewer stomata (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 3q-r, 7k-q). Single study. Caution: protoplasting-affected (Table S5 log2FC 6.9, low baseMean).
EPF2-family secreted peptide (AtEPF2 homolog); cluster enrichment only (Early GC lfc 4.0, pct 0.68; also GMC clusters) in Berg et al. 2026. No in situ.

PANGLOSS1 LRR-RLK that polarizes at the GMC/SMC interface to orient SMC divisions (Zhang et al. 2022 eLife). Polarity is protein-level: the BdPAN1-YFP reporter is in all young protodermal cells, and in Berg et al. 2026 it is weakly enriched (pct 0.11) only in the SMC cluster, a label rejected in review. Do not use to call SMCs.
ERECTA-LIKE1 receptor kinase; RNA-FISH in stomatal files (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 5f-h) but broad: also enriched in Stage 0-2, inter-specialized and Unclear cluster 23. Use only as support.

bHLH for guard-cell differentiation; YFP-BdFAMA reporter from stage 3 GMCs rising in young GCs, mutant and overexpression phenotypes (McKown et al. 2023 Plant Cell); transcriptional reporter (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 3h-i); Early GC/Dividing GMC lfc 4.2-4.7. Cross-study raise from medium (late GMC to young GC only).
GDSL esterase/lipase; RNA-FISH in stage 6 GCs (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 4m-o); Late GC lfc 8.8, pct 0.68. Maize ZmGELP1 is a GC reporter (Sun et al. 2022), an ortholog, not the same gene.
MYB60 homolog (AtMYB60 is guard-cell specific); Late GC cluster lfc 8.7, pct 0.77 in Berg et al. 2026, no in situ.
Dof TF homologous to AtSCAP1 (GC maturation); Early/Late GC lfc 4.2-4.7 but pct 0.16-0.19 in Berg et al. 2026; no in situ.

CLOSED STOMATA1 clade I SWEET; Bd transcriptional reporter specific to mature SCs (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 3k-l); maize ortholog SC-localized with stomatal-opening function (Wang et al. 2019 Plant Cell). Not enriched at Table S4 thresholds (late, low expression in this developmental zone).
Uncharacterized tubby-C/DUF567 protein; transcriptional reporter specific to SCs from early stage 6 (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 3n-o); SC cluster lfc 7.8, pct 0.18.

Class III peroxidase lignifying the prickle-hair base; transcriptional and translational reporters exclusively in prickle hair cells, bdpox has smaller hairs (Nunes et al. 2023 Curr Biol); HC feature plot in Berg et al. 2026 Fig 2f and whole-atlas cluster 27 lfc 7.6 (pct 0.47 vs 0.005), HC-lineage clusters 14/23. Cross-study. Added at collation (not in the review list).
Two-component response regulator; RNA-FISH in prickle hair cells (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 2j-k); HC-lineage clusters lfc 3.1-3.9, pct 0.51-0.73.

Siliplant1-like proline-rich protein; multiplex RNA-FISH in prickle hair cells (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 2n-o); HC-lineage pct 0.86-0.99. One of nine Bd SLP1-like paralogs: do not swap for another.

WOX3 homeobox; rice OsWOX3B/DEP is required for leaf trichome formation (Angeles-Shim et al. 2012). In Berg et al. 2026 it marks the HC precursor cluster (epidermis cl24 lfc 6.1, pct 0.40); no Bd in situ. Precursor stage only.

Siliplant1-like protein (SbSLP1 drives silica deposition, Kumar et al. 2020); multiplex RNA-FISH in silica-cell precursors at stage 5 (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 2n-o), epidermis cluster 9 lfc 4.7, pct 0.61. Conflict: also in hair cells from stage 6 (HC clusters 14/23); read with BdSLP1-like5/BdPOX absent.
PROTODERMAL FACTOR1 homolog; enriched in every epidermal cluster (whole-atlas pct 0.52-0.91) in Berg et al. 2026, no Bd in situ. Pan-epidermal.

HD-ZIP IV (AtHDG2 homolog); transcriptional reporter in the early leaf epidermis (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig S3l-m); epidermal clusters lfc 2.5-3.5. Caution: protoplasting-induced (Table S5 log2FC 9.1).
HD-ZIP IV (AtPDF2 homolog); enriched in young epidermal clusters (lfc 1.5-3.0, pct 0.25-0.45) in Berg et al. 2026, no in situ.
STOMAGEN-family peptide secreted by mesophyll (AtSTOMAGEN, TaSTOMAGEN); weak, broad mesophyll enrichment (lfc 0.8-1.5, pct 0.27-0.44) in Berg et al. 2026; no in situ.
ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT MYB homolog (AtAPL: SE/CC identity); vascular clusters 17/20 lfc 4.4-5.8, pct 0.31-0.48 in Berg et al. 2026; no Bd in situ. SE vs CC not resolved.

Clade III SWEET (maize SWEET13a-c export sucrose from phloem parenchyma/abaxial BS; Bezrutczyk et al. 2021 Plant Cell). In Berg et al. 2026 below Table S4 thresholds, so its cluster is unverified, and it is protoplasting-induced (Table S5 log2FC 9.2).
Lipid-transfer-like protein homologous to Zinnia TED4 (tracheary element differentiation); cluster 19 lfc 7.8, pct 0.45 in Berg et al. 2026. Conflict: the authors script labels cluster 19 Procambium.
Papain-like cysteine protease homologous to AtXCP1 (tracheary-element cell death); SAM/Vasculature cluster 11 lfc 7.2, pct 0.26 in Berg et al. 2026; no in situ.
WOX4 homeobox (OsWOX4 vascular/meristem function; AtWOX4 procambium). Named for the mitotic SAM/vasculature cluster 21 in Berg et al. 2026 but not enriched at Table S4 thresholds; no in situ.

GRAS TF (OsDLT ortholog); RNA-FISH in dividing leaf cells and bdgras32 has more, smaller cells (Berg et al. 2026 Plant Cell Fig 7c-j); top G2/M-phase gene (lfc 2.6, pct 0.23 vs 0.05). Single study; pair with core G2/M genes.
Class I KNOX (ZmKN1 ortholog; meristem maintenance); named as a SAM marker in Berg et al. 2026 but not enriched at Table S4 thresholds; no Bd validation.
CLAVATA1 LRR-RLK (HvCLV1, OsFON1, ZmTD1); used for SAM/primordium with barley spatial data only (Berg et al. 2026 Fig S3a-b); low detection.
FON2-LIKE CLE peptide (OsFCP1, ZmFCP1 expressed in leaf primordia); SAM/primordium assignment supported by a barley reporter only (Berg et al. 2026 Fig S3g); low detection.
YABBY CRABS CLAW/DROOPING LEAF homolog; barley HvCRC marks leaf founder cells and primordia by Molecular Cartography (Berg et al. 2026 Fig S3c-d citing Demesa-Arevalo et al.); low detection in Bd.
